pieces.Text: A vemerak's acid breath weapon has no effect on inorganic or undead material.  If the breath weapon deals damage to a living fleshy creature, the acid creates a transparent cloud of foul-smelling vapor that fills that creature's space and persists for 1 round.  Any creature in or passing through the cloud must make a DC
Fortitude save or be nauseated for 1d4 rounds.  This cloud is a poison effect.
